kpis.description_fr: Comp sales growth FY25. KPI #1 off-price retail. Sous-performe TJX/ROST. Plan transformation 'Burlington 2.0' en cours.
kpis.description_en: FY25 comp sales growth. #1 off-price retail KPI. Underperforms TJX/ROST. 'Burlington 2.0' transformation plan in progress.

kpis.description_fr: Total magasins FY25. Plan expansion agressif (+100/an cible). Format prototype 25K sqft (vs ancien 80K).
kpis.description_en: FY25 total stores. Aggressive expansion plan (+100/year target). 25K sqft prototype format (vs old 80K).

kpis.description_fr: Ouvertures FY25 (131 nouveaux - 9 fermetures). Cible 2000 stores long-terme (+800 vs aujourd'hui). Sweet spot smaller-format productivity.
kpis.description_en: FY25 openings (131 new - 9 closed). 2000 stores long-term target (+800 vs today). Smaller-format productivity sweet spot.

kpis.description_fr: Part reserve inventory (pack-away saisonnier) FY25. Stratégie clé off-price : achète closeouts/cancellations à 50-70% off, stocke pour la saison suivante.
kpis.description_en: FY25 reserve inventory share (seasonal pack-away). Key off-price strategy: buys closeouts/cancellations at 50-70% off, stores for next season.

kpis.description_fr: Réserves auto-assurance FY25 ($111M). Self-insurance retentions élevées (workers comp, general liability). Discipline risque pour grand format retailer.
kpis.description_en: FY25 self-insurance reserves ($111M). High self-insurance retentions (workers comp, general liability). Risk discipline for big-format retailer.

kpis_story.description_fr: Plan Burlington 2.0 lancé 2024 par O'Sullivan : smaller-format stores, pricing more competitive vs TJX/Ross, inventory mgmt repensé, allocation merchandise optimisée. Cible +200-300bps marge op d'ici 2028.
kpis_story.description_en: Burlington 2.0 plan launched 2024 by O'Sullivan: smaller-format stores, more competitive pricing vs TJX/Ross, rethought inventory mgmt, optimized merchandise allocation. +200-300bps op margin target by 2028.

_notes: Off-price retailer. Source: 10-K FY25 filed Mar 2026. Added Insurance Reserves to reach 5 KPIs.
